notes.title: Woodlands UPDATE 0.2!
notes.notes:
Hey survivors! Today we have taken a small step into the progression of Woodlands. We know an update has been long awaited, but today is the day!

PATCH NOTES:

- ADDED START MENU:
We've implemented a new start menu including:

 - Play button which will then allow you to select your scene (currently only one map to chose from)
 - Your save loader (Yes, we have FINALLY almost completed that save option!). This will allow you to select which save you wish to load.
 - Credits which simply directs you to the credits scene.
 - Options which gives you a selection of graphic options, and allows you to change the in-game audio.
 - Exit to windows which simply exits the game.


The current look of the menu in this update is just a placeholder. Although the main layout of the menu will stay the same throughout later updates, we do plan to replace graphics and music further down the road when it is more prioritized.

- ADDED A SAVE LOADER:
As stated in the main menu section, we have added a load save option. At the moment this feature is being used in testing until we can bring it to you properly. The save loader is functioning, and we are currently working on allow saves so you can properly use the function. This is a huge feature that is needed in a game as such, and therefore we are prioritizing the save option and are going to work on it every update to improve its state as development continues.

- BUG FIXES:
Minor bug fixes & optimization

SAVE OPTION:
Yes, we've read your comments! We know a save system is something a lot of players want, and we are completely on board! As you can probably tell with the new update, we have created a load system to load up any available saves. This feature does work, however cannot currently be used outside of the developer build as we are still perfecting the save system itself, but just so you are aware, the save system is almost here! We know it's been a long wait, but fortunately that wait is almost over!


We know this is only a small step towards the progression and development state we wish to get to with Woodlands, but we think its definitely a small step in the right direction, and hope you can agree. From now on, we are going to show our community that we wish to further the progress of Woodlands through new content and updates, rather than empty announcements and words.


Welp, that's it for today!

Thanks,
AcuzeTM
